articles.title: Apple's New iPhone 18 Pro Can Change Its Camera Like a Pro!
articles.summary: Apple just showed off the iPhone 18 Pro with a camera that can change its aperture—like your eye's pupil! It also has a battery that lasts up to 30 hours. Cool, right?

articles.title: Tennis Match Ends at 3:34 AM! Shelton Beats Alcaraz in a Five-Set Thriller
articles.summary: Ben Shelton beat Carlos Alcaraz in a five-set tennis match that ended at 3:34 AM—the latest finish in US Open history! It lasted over four hours. Wow!

articles.title: Mystery Humans Lived in a Chinese Cave for 100,000 Years—We Just Found Their Arm Bone!
articles.summary: Scientists found a Denisovan arm bone in a Chinese cave—the first ever! They also found tools and animal bones showing these ancient humans lived there for 100,000 years.
